name: cadkit
description: From idea to printed, wired and working maker project: a project file (idea, components, pins, power budget, build plan) with checks, /idea, /electronics, /enclosure, /firmware, /plan, /bringup and /log skills, a compile-on-edit hook, plus pre-print validation for FreeCAD designs printed on a Bambu Lab printer (manifest, geometry/fastener/fit checks against your calibrated tolerances, a print gate, review, print-settings and BOM skills).
